component.name: Reinked
component.summary: Comic Chat client with a software-rendered comic framebuffer

description.p: Reinked is a portable Comic Chat client. It talks IRC/IRCX over verified TLS and presents rooms as software-rendered comic pages on native X11, Wayland, and Win32 backends.
The Linux desktop files register .ccc conversations and .ccr locators. A nonempty WAYLAND_DISPLAY selects Wayland; there is no automatic X11 fallback.
